behavior: Empty Fallback targets are split into basic strategies and proxies.
Default-selected targets are split into the default option and current group members.
The active selection is marked and the selection sheet returns the chosen draft value immediately.
Search appears at 10 total candidates; terms are whitespace-separated and all must match the label.
The search expands from the page top bar and backs out before leaving the selector.
The selected row is revealed around the viewport center when scroll bounds allow it.
